sources.note: Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory Graduate School 'How to Apply' page (cshl.edu, the awarding institution's own domain). Read live; states the cycle is open, the application deadline, eligibility requirements, and the stipend/funding package. The on-page FAQ (accordion in page HTML) confirms no minimum GPA and the December 1 deadline.
CSHL 'About the Graduate School' page on cshl.edu. Confirms the School of Biological Sciences' identity, accreditation, and that the programme trains students to a PhD.

awarding_body.detail: The page is on cshl.edu, Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory's own domain, under 'Home / Graduate School', with footer '© 2026 Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory. All Rights Reserved.' The About page names the school explicitly, matching the record's awarding body.
awarding_body.quote: Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory School of Biological Sciences is accredited by the New England Commission of Higher Education (formerly the Commission on Institutions of Higher Education of the New England Association of Schools and Colleges, Inc.).

deadline.detail: Read on 12 October 2026, the page states the cycle is currently open ('Applications are now open.') and that applications must be submitted by December 1. There is a single annual admission cycle with an August start, so the currently open cycle's deadline is 1 December 2026, matching the record. The FAQ adds that the December 1 deadline applies without exception to all materials including recommendation letters.
deadline.quote: Applications are now open. Applications must be submitted online by December 1.

eligibility.detail: Every distinct eligibility claim in the record is confirmed on the page: bachelor's degree or equivalent required by enrolment; applicants from any area of biology and from non-bioscience backgrounds (computer science, engineering, math, chemistry, physics) are encouraged; TOEFL/IELTS required for applicants from non-English-language universities; GRE not required; and the FAQ states there is no minimum GPA requirement.
eligibility.quote: The School encourages applicants with backgrounds in any area of biology as well as those with non-bioscience backgrounds, such as computer science, engineering, math, chemistry, and physics. Students must have received a bachelor's degree or equivalent by the time they enroll in the program. The application consists of unofficial transcripts, a personal statement, and three letters of recommendation. Students from non-English language universities must submit TOEFL or IELTS test scores. The GRE general test and subject test(s) are not required. Applications must be submitted online by December 1st.

funding.detail: The 'Fully Funded' claim is supported: a yearly stipend of $50,000, all tuition and study fees paid by the School, a laptop and textbooks (~$3,500), a $2,000/year research cost allowance once in a lab, and full health and dental insurance, relocation costs, subsidized dining and a gym allowance. This is far more than a tuition-only award.
funding.quote: The Ph.D. program stipend is currently $50,000 per year. Students who are awarded an external fellowship—NSF, NIH, or other government or private organization—receive a stipend of $55,000, or the amount of their fellowships stipend (whichever is higher). The School pays all tuition costs and associated study fees for its students. Students receive a new laptop and all necessary software and textbooks, roughly $3,500 of materials. Once students join a research lab, they receive an $2,000 per year research cost allowance, intended to help support their thesis work, paid to their lab. Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory and the School provide complete health and dental insurance, affordable on-campus child care, relocation costs, subsidized on-campus dining costs, and a $350 gym membership allowance.

degree_levels.detail: The School of Biological Sciences offers a single doctoral programme; the record's 'PhD' degree level matches.
degree_levels.quote: Enable students to complete their PhD in an accelerated timeframe, while maintaining the highest standards of excellence.

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: Applications must be submitted online by December 1.
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Checked live on 2026-10-12 against cshl.edu; the plain HTTP fetch is bot-blocked (403) but the page reads correctly in a browser. Single annual admission cycle: applications open in September (the 2026 cycle opened September 2026 and was open when checked) and close December 1 with no exceptions, including recommendation letters; the academic year starts in August only. The stipend figure ($50,000/year, $55,000 with an external fellowship) and materials/allowance amounts are published numbers that can change year to year, so re-quote them at the next check. Note CSHL also runs a separate BioAI PhD programme with a rolling deadline from December 15 — a distinct programme, do not merge into this record.
